title: Grateful Dead Live at San Antonio Civic Auditorium on 1971-11-12
source: Source: Sbd > master reel (vault) > reel (dick latvala) > dat 48k (rob Eaton); Transfer: Dat > Sony R500 > Sound Devices 744T > wav 16/48; transfer by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav 16/48 > Adobe Audition 3.0.1 > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > iZotope RX4 advanced > wav 16/44.1 > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick

ai_review.summary: Heavily distorted recording with an out‑of‑tune performance makes this show difficult to enjoy.
ai_review.review: The sole reviewer describes the audio as very distorted and notes that the band sounded out of tune throughout, indicating both technical and musical shortcomings. With no redeeming moments mentioned, the recording offers little value for listeners seeking a clear Dead experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 1‑star review citing severe distortion and tuning problems; both show and recording quality are judged poor.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a very distorted recording, implying heavy noise/muddiness and lack of clarity.
